gen-gf-rasa-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and bookish, Rasa packs its letters tightly, with heavy verticals and lighter horizontals pulling gently against each other. Bespoke Sans follows in sharp, sans-serif lines.
gen-gf-rationale-fs-literata: Tucked-in, friendly letterforms up top, like folded paper fans. Literata follows with sturdy thin strokes and open, wide-mouthed curves that carry a bookish, sophisticated tone down the page.
gen-gf-red-hat-mono-fs-bespoke-sans: Sharp and refined, with generous room between where curves end and the stem begins. Bespoke Sans sits under Red Hat Mono, whose pencil-like monospace lines never press harder anywhere, so the sans reads as the more finished voice.
gen-gf-red-hat-mono-fs-literata: Precise and structured, Red Hat Mono draws every bar as heavy as its stems, like a technical pen. Literata moves in with a middling spread of thick and thin strokes, giving the page a bookish counterweight.
gen-gf-red-hat-text-fs-literata: Modern and contemporary, Red Hat Text keeps its strokes uniform. Literata brings a mild, friendly stroke contrast and wide-mouthed curves beneath it, so the text serif feels warmer than the heading.
gen-gf-red-rose-inter: Red Rose takes charge with an x-height that fills the middle of the line and an open e. Inter follows with big, breathing counters and smooth, tube-like strokes, though a small heading would lose that commanding presence.
gen-gf-red-rose-mulish: Big, distinctive letters with a tall middle and an open e. And Mulish, a sans-serif with a constant-width line and horseshoe-open curves, leaves Red Rose to earn its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-red-rose-poppins: Commanding letters with a middle zone that fills the line and an e left clearly open. Poppins steps in with the steady line of a drafting pen and rope-loose curves, a quiet sans-serif beneath the heading's drama.
gen-gf-red-rose-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab builds a texture where the middle zone dominates each line, with open throats on a, c, e and s. And Red Rose, a commanding display face, adds a distinctive voice above that structured slab-serif.
gen-gf-red-rose-rubik: Rubik looks soft and clean, with big lowercase next to its capitals. Its open, round letters stay clear at small sizes, and that friendliness against Red Rose's commanding display shapes is the pair's real charm.
